'''Tributary''' was a structure located on the artificial world of [[Iokath]], next to the [[Chromium Garden]]. In [[3630 BBY]], [[ARIES]] trapped the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] leadership on Iokath and [[Theron Shan]], assuming the [[Tributary]] to be a secured location, picked it as a temporary base for the Alliance forces on Iokath. However, soon after the last Alliance members arrived, [[Droid/Legends|droids]] attacked from the Chromium Garden outside. [[Alliance Commander|The Alliance Commander]] and [[Vette]] went to search for another exist inside the [[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Necropolis]] and the entire team later used a [[Colossus droid]] to fight off smaller droids outside while buying themselves time to escape in a shuttle through on the Tributary roof.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tributary appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' "Chapter IV: Where Dreams Die" and "Chapter V: Ascension."
